games.name: Sequence Memory
games.desc: Repeat an ever-growing pattern of tiles.

games.name: Number Memory
games.desc: Remember the longest number you can.

games.name: Word Recall
games.desc: Seen this word before, or is it new?

games.name: Number Order
games.desc: Tap the numbers 1 to 9 in order, as fast as you can.

games.name: Visual Memory
games.desc: Memorize and recall the lit squares.

games.name: Target Pop
games.desc: Pop 20 targets as fast as you can.

games.name: Typing Speed
games.desc: How many words per minute can you type?

games.name: CPS Test
games.desc: Clicks per second in 5 seconds. The classic click-speed test.

games.name: Spacebar Speed
games.desc: Smash the spacebar as many times as you can in 5 seconds.

games.name: Tracking Trainer
games.desc: Keep your cursor on a drifting target for 10 seconds.

games.name: Colour Spot
games.desc: Find the one square with a slightly different colour. It gets harder each level.

games.name: Edge Flash
games.desc: Keep your eyes on the centre dot and click the targets that flash at the edges.

games.name: Track Three
games.desc: Remember the highlighted dot, then track it as it moves and pick it out.

games.name: Ghost Tap
games.desc: A dot slips behind a wall. Tap the exact moment it crosses the line.

games.name: Dual Mind
games.desc: Two zones, two rules. Tap green on the left and blue on the right, and ignore the rest.

games.name: Blink
games.desc: A number flashes for a moment, then vanishes. Type it back. It gets longer and faster.

games.name: Nerve
games.desc: Stop the moving marker as close to the red line as you can, without going over.

games.name: Colour Trap
games.desc: The word names one colour but is printed in another. Tap the ink colour.

games.name: Flip
games.desc: Tap the colour named. The rule changes halfway, so stay sharp.

games.name: Mirror
games.desc: A cell lights up on the left. Tap its mirror image on the right.

games.name: Pulse
games.desc: Tap exactly one second after the light goes dark. No counting, just your internal clock.

games.name: Schulte Table
games.desc: Tap the numbers 1 to 25 in order, as fast as you can.

games.name: Bullseye
games.desc: The ring shrinks inward. Tap as it reaches the green band.

games.name: Cascade
games.desc: Tiles fall in four lanes. Tap the lane as each tile reaches the line.

games.name: Sprint
games.desc: An endless runner. Switch lanes to dodge the blocks. Three crashes and it ends.

games.name: Target Rush
games.desc: Hit as many targets as you can in 15 seconds. Speed and accuracy both count.

games.name: Speed Round
games.desc: A 30-second reaction marathon. How many clean reactions can you land?

games.name: Dodge
games.desc: Tap the green, leave the red alone. A quick go/no-go arena.

games.name: Impossible Mode
games.desc: The reaction window shrinks every level. One slip ends the run.

tips.seq: Learn the shape of the pattern, not each tile on its own.
tips.num: Group the digits into pairs or small chunks, like 47 · 92.
tips.word: Make a quick picture or short story for each word you see.
tips.ord: Scan the whole board first, then tap in order without searching again.
tips.vis: Group the lit squares into shapes, like a corner or a row, and remember the shape.
tips.pop: Keep your eyes moving ahead of the target, so you click as soon as it appears.
tips.type: Keep your eyes on the text, not the keyboard, and use all ten fingers.
tips.cps: Use a steady rhythm. Relax your hand and avoid tensing up.
tips.space: Use quick, light taps. Holding the key does not count as extra presses.
tips.track: Follow the centre of the target, not its edge, and keep the cursor close.
